about: Every fixture is a complete mini Mission Control home (json and jsonl files only). Authentic ones were captured from the real engine (dist/run.js and dist/cli.js) with scripted stand-ins for the two AI CLIs; synthetic ones are written by hand in the shape of the authentic files and exist for what no capture contains.
reductions: Absolute paths were replaced: the capture's .mission-control folder by /fixture/.mission-control and its mc-apps folder by /fixture/mc-apps.
dispatch.json was reduced to its one key the dashboard reads, finalVerify (copied verbatim), or {} when the real one had none. The other keys hold absolute paths and a copy of the app's .git/config.
No report.md, guards, worktrees, reports, logs or screenshots were copied. File modification times do not survive a copy; the tests set them.
honestLimits: The AI answers, titles and prose in authentic fixtures are scripted and not representative of real agent text.
Durations are milliseconds because the scripted AIs answer at once.
No capture has a usage reading, a feature that failed and then passed, a fix- or onboard run, a repair round, a mid-run mc.lock or a mid-run dispatch.json.
The events of limit-then-done and the reader mission of multi-mission jump from 09:58 to 12:59 because the capture used a fake clock for the wait.

The four checkpoint-* fixtures were written by hand from the design in docs/checkpoints-spec.md, before the engine that writes them existed. They hold the engine's wording of the lines only as a guess. The test that runs the real engine to a checkpoint and builds a snapshot from its home replaces that trust.

done.pins: all-done green, four ticks yes, steps 1 of 5, the timeline of a clean run

partial-blocked.pins: one stuck and one left-out feature, the architect's block reason, 3 of 5 steps, Delivered and Nothing open not met

midrun-reviewing.pins: the now line while a feature is reviewed (review-add-task)

limit-then-done.pins: the wait inside a finished timeline

failed-auth.pins: a failed, retryable mission after both logins expired

multi-mission.pins: ordering, counts, scoping with different clocks, hidden old missions

all-event-types.pins: the timeline translation of every event type; the unknown type is hidden

recovered.pins: the Recovered after a retry list, steps 2 of 5, the retry note on the No rework tick

final-verify-red.source: hand-made: a partly done mission whose dispatch.json finalVerify has ok false
final-verify-red.pins: the Final review passed tick not met (the final tests failed)

old-dispatch-no-reviewed.source: hand-made: a finished mission whose dispatch.json finalVerify has no reviewed key (written before it existed)
old-dispatch-no-reviewed.pins: an absent reviewed counts as finished: the tick is met

feature-review-unfinished-note.source: hand-made: a finished mission with the engine's note that a feature was merged after its own review did not finish
feature-review-unfinished-note.pins: the caveat on the Final review passed tick; the tick stays met

final-review-blocking.source: hand-made: every feature done, status partial, finalVerify blocking 2 and the engine's Have someone check the app decision
final-review-blocking.pins: partly done with every feature built; the tick not met; one question card

quota-readings.source: hand-made quota.json in the exact shape of QuotaGovernor.save(): Claude five_hour 0.62 and seven_day 0.41, Codex seven_day 0.18 only; every reset is ahead of the test clock 2026-10-11T09:58:30Z
quota-readings.pins: gauges with pause ticks; Codex without a 5-hour window. No capture holds a usage reading

quota-nearly-out.source: hand-made quota.json: Claude five_hour 0.91 and seven_day 0.80, Codex seven_day 0.74
quota-nearly-out.pins: the Nearly out and Getting low pills (0.86 weekly would already be past the weekly pause cap, see quota-paced)

quota-expired.source: hand-made quota.json: readings whose reset has passed and a limit that has ended
quota-expired.pins: expired readings and limits are dropped

quota-overage.source: hand-made quota.json: Claude five_hour 1.04, Codex a 180_minutes window at 1.2
quota-overage.pins: overage: the bar stops at full; paced windows wait for reset, others are nearly out

quota-limited.source: hand-made quota.json: a Claude weekly limits entry (with the provider's raw text) and a Codex model block
quota-limited.pins: limit entries and model blocks; the raw text is never shown

quota-corrupt.source: hand-made: a quota.json cut off in the middle
quota-corrupt.pins: a quota file that cannot be read counts as absent

quota-paced.source: hand-made quota.json: Claude seven_day 0.9 and five_hour 0.98 with empty limits, Codex seven_day 0.30
quota-paced.pins: the engine blocks a provider at its pause cap without writing a limits entry (E47)

login-wait.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: a mission asleep until 12:59 whose wait reason also names a Claude login
login-wait.pins: wait cause login, the login card, an amber lamp at any length

hostile-strings.pins: cleaning and capping of every string

trouble-wait.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: a mission asleep for 15 minutes because both AIs keep failing
trouble-wait.pins: wait cause trouble and a short wait (green with a note)

unknown-wait.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: a mission asleep with a wait reason that matches no known shape

paused-disk.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: a stopped mission whose mission.stopped reason is the engine's low-disk message

paused-ai-failing.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: a stopped mission whose reason says the AI command lines keep failing

paused-deadline.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: a stopped mission whose reason is the engine's deadline message (a wait for a limit that would end after the stop time, src/executor.ts waitForCandidate: the only path that writes the reason deadline)
paused-deadline.pins: pausedWhy deadline, worded as no AI being free before the stop time, unbuilt features waiting for the next run

paused-stop.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: a stopped mission whose reason is stop requested. Verified against the real engine for the review fixes: the engine's run function with a hung scripted AI and --until 07:00, advanced past 07:00, writes exactly this reason (the stop control aborts on the stop time like on the STOP file), so this fixture also stands for a run that reached its stop time
paused-stop.pins: pausedWhy stop_requested, worded for a stop request or the stop time (never on request or at the planned time)

baseline-broken.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: a change mission whose project checks were already failing, with a red gate-c and a green gate-c-features verify event
baseline-broken.pins: baselineBroken, the checks_failing card, the red-baseline wording

unknown-status.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: one mission with an unknown status and one with a feature of an unknown status

unreadable-mission.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: one valid mission and one whose mission.json is cut off in the middle

no-mission-json.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: one valid mission and a folder with no mission.json
no-mission-json.pins: a folder without mission.json is not a mission

duplicate-titles.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: two missions called Habit tracker, one with two features called Weekly chart, one with two open questions
duplicate-titles.pins: ids in the tell-the-leader sentences, question 1 of 2

waiting-then-running.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: the reader mission saved as waiting, with an agent started after the wait

stale-busy-under-live-run.pins: a leftover under a live run is paused, never the worked mission

restart-midnight.pins: earlier work stays recent after a restart

checkpoint-plan.source: hand-made in the shape of the checkpoint design (docs/checkpoints-spec.md, section 4): a new app stopped before its foundation is built, status stopped, stage init, a pending plan checkpoint, the events of a plan up to checkpoint.parked
checkpoint-plan.pins: state paused with pausedWhy checkpoint, the checkpoint card with the plan's lines, the amber checkpoint_waiting lamp reason, the parked timeline line

checkpoint-feature.source: hand-made in the shape of the checkpoint design (docs/checkpoints-spec.md, section 4): a change stopped after the review of one feature and before it is added, a pending feature checkpoint, the feature still in review
checkpoint-feature.pins: a feature checkpoint card that names the feature, the feature tile read as paused for the check, the parked line that names the feature

checkpoint-final.source: hand-made in the shape of the checkpoint design (docs/checkpoints-spec.md, section 4): a new app with every feature done, stopped at stage finalize before it is finished, a pending final checkpoint and a green final check in dispatch.json
checkpoint-final.pins: a final checkpoint card, no Results entry for a mission that waits for a check, the finished-app wording

checkpoint-answered.source: hand-made in the shape of the checkpoint design (docs/checkpoints-spec.md, section 4): the plan checkpoint was approved (state answered, the checkpoint.answered event written) and no run has continued the mission yet
checkpoint-answered.pins: state paused with pausedWhy checkpoint and the sentence You answered, no card, no lamp reason, the approved timeline line

dispatch-with-secret.source: hand-made by agent 1A in the shape of the authentic files: the done mission with a full dispatch.json whose gitSettings hold a fake push token
dispatch-with-secret.pins: the token and the paths of dispatch.json never reach the snapshot
